Principal AI Engineering Lead, Translational Medicine

Northwind Therapeutics - Remote, United States

Full time

Northwind Therapeutics develops small-molecule therapies for fibrotic disease.
Our Translational Medicine group connects preclinical findings, biomarker data
and early clinical trial results to decide which programs move forward.

About the role
We are seeking a Principal AI Engineering Lead, Translational Medicine to build
the AI systems our translational scientists use to assemble and weigh evidence
across programs.

What you will do
- Architect and personally implement the agent-based pipeline that assembles
  biomarker evidence, preclinical study results and early trial readouts into
  reviewable program summaries, including state handling, verification of each
  cited source, and recovery when an intermediate step fails.
- Work with translational scientists and clinical pharmacologists to turn their
  evidence questions into evaluable system behavior.
- Define evaluation sets with domain experts and report accuracy against them.
- Keep provenance from every generated statement back to the study, assay or
  trial record it came from.
- Mentor two engineers working on the evidence pipeline.

What you bring
- 8+ years building software, including 3+ years shipping LLM or agent systems
  to production users.
- Working knowledge of drug development data: preclinical assays, biomarkers,
  clinical trial data, or pharmacology.
- Experience with Python and one major cloud platform.
- A track record of working directly with scientists or clinicians as users.

Nice to have
- Experience with CDISC-structured trial data or pharmacokinetic models.
- An advanced degree in a life science, pharmacy or a quantitative field.

Northwind Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer.
why: Domain-tied AI lead; hands-on implementation is a duty, not the occupation.

Senior ML Platform Engineer

Contoso Retail Cloud - Remote, United States

Full time

Contoso Retail Cloud runs the recommendation and search systems behind a large
online marketplace.

About the role
We are hiring a Senior ML Platform Engineer to build and run the infrastructure
our machine learning teams train, deploy and monitor models on.

What you will do
- Build and operate the model training and serving platform on Kubernetes,
  including GPU scheduling, autoscaling and rollout tooling.
- Own the feature store and the batch and streaming pipelines that feed it.
- Provide CI/CD, model registry and monitoring as self-service tools for data
  scientists.
- Improve reliability, latency and cost of online inference for ranking models.
- Participate in the on-call rotation for platform services.

What you bring
- 6+ years of software or infrastructure engineering, 3+ years on ML platforms.
- Strong Python and Go; Terraform and Kubernetes in production.
- Experience with Spark or Flink and a feature store such as Feast.
- Experience running model serving at high request volume.

Contoso Retail Cloud is an equal opportunity employer.
why: ML platform engineering for retail search with no life-science tie.

Pharmacy Operations Supervisor

Woodgrove Health - Columbus, Ohio

Full time

About the role
The Pharmacy Operations Supervisor leads the evening team of pharmacy
technicians at our central fill site.

What you will do
- Supervise a team of 14 pharmacy technicians: hiring, scheduling, coaching and
  annual performance reviews.
- Approve time off, manage overtime and resolve staffing gaps each shift.
- Hold daily huddles and track team productivity against fill targets.
- Escalate safety events to the pharmacist in charge.

What you bring
- 3+ years supervising hourly staff in a pharmacy or health care setting.
- Active pharmacy technician certification.
- Strong scheduling and people management skills.

Woodgrove Health is an equal opportunity employer.
why: Supervising technicians defines the job; the health setting does not change that.

Staff Machine Learning Scientist, Drug Discovery

Tailspin Biosciences - Remote, United States

Full time

Tailspin Biosciences designs small-molecule drugs for rare metabolic disease.

About the role
We are hiring a Staff Machine Learning Scientist, Drug Discovery to build the
models our medicinal chemists use to choose which compounds to make next.

What you will do
- Build and validate property-prediction and generative models for small
  molecules, trained on our assay and ADMET data.
- Work with medicinal chemists and biologists to turn design questions into
  modeling problems and to read results against experimental outcomes.
- Own model training pipelines and their deployment to the chemistry team.
- Design prospective tests of model predictions with the wet lab.

What you bring
- PhD or equivalent experience in computational chemistry, cheminformatics,
  machine learning, or a related field.
- 5+ years applying machine learning to molecular or biological data.
- Strong Python and PyTorch; experience with RDKit.

Tailspin Biosciences is an equal opportunity employer.
why: ML engineering tied to small-molecule drug discovery, a life-science domain the boundary keeps, so it does not fire.
